profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer + Applied Machine Learning Engineer
profile.summary: I'm Ja'Quan Taylor, a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience designing and building scalable backend systems using Java, Python, Spring Boot, and AWS. Proven track record leading high-impact projects, including architecting a disaster recovery solution for a complex legacy system and optimizing distributed systems with Elasticsearch. While rooted in software engineering, I’ve also applied machine learning using PyTorch and scikit-learn to explore data-driven solutions in production environments. Passionate about continuous learning, mentoring engineers, and solving real-world problems with clean, reliable code.

positions.title: Technical Lead (via J-Mack Technologies)
positions.description:
• Modernized legacy Java applications by migrating authentication flows to MFA using Spring Security, improving system security and aligning with federal compliance standards.
• Developed and maintained scalable RESTful services with Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JPA, supporting a high-traffic government-facing web application.
• Diagnosed and resolved critical backend issues across distributed systems using JIRA, log analysis, and collaborative debugging, reducing average incident resolution time by 30%.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented a resilient disaster recovery solution using Spring Boot, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch), and Elasticsearch, cutting system downtime from over 8 hours to under 30 minutes and saving millions in potential losses.
• Modernized legacy infrastructure by integrating distributed Java services with AWS cloud tools and observability via CloudWatch, boosting uptime(by 30%) and operational visibility.
• Enhanced real-time analytics capabilities by optimizing Spring Boot services with Elasticsearch, significantly improving performance for call tracking and transcription use cases.

positions.title: AI/ML Ops Engineer and Senior Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
• Built a serverless anomaly detection system using AWS Lambda, CloudWatch, PyTorch, and scikit-learn to monitor ETL workflows and detect data drift, migration latency spikes, and system resource anomalies, ensuring a seamless and compliant transition from Oracle to PostgreSQL
• Designed and built a Java-based middleware application to automate the migration of customer data from a legacy Oracle system to a modern PostgreSQL database, reducing manual effort and ensuring high reliability
• Developed Python scripts to validate migrated data, perform integrity checks, and generate detailed reports for audit and compliance teams
• Engineered end-to-end ETL workflows using Java, SQL, and Python, enabling a seamless and low-risk migration process that supported ongoing operations with zero downtime

positions.title: Data Engineer – Python & ETL Specialist (Contract)
positions.description:
• Engineered robust ETL pipelines using Python, Pandas, and SQL to process and transform millions of legal and customer records into Oracle and MongoDB, improving data accessibility for downstream applications
• Utilized Pandas and NumPy to perform complex data cleansing, statistical analysis, and transformation tasks, enabling accurate reporting and accelerating analytics delivery by 40%
• Created reusable Python modules for data validation, schema enforcement, and automated quality checks, reducing manual QA time and ensuring consistency across pipeline stages

positions.title: Minority Outreach Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed and delivered interactive computer science lessons using Java, Python, Greenfoot, and Finch Robots, increasing student engagement through hands-on programming
• Led outreach programs targeting underrepresented high school students, boosting AP Computer Science A pass rates and fostering long-term interest in tech careers
• Developed K-12 computer science curricula aligned with educational standards, improving digital literacy and problem-solving skills across diverse student groups

positions.title: Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Boosted system throughput by {30%} by optimizing utility data processing with Java and Spring for municipal clients.
• Implemented machine learning models such as k-NN using Python, Pandas, and Scikit-learn to analyze smart meter data and detect consumption anomalies
• Designed and developed backend systems from end to end using Java and Spring to support smart grid data processing for utility companies

positions.title: Google Ambassador
positions.description:
A Google Ambassador has several task within its university. Including:
- Lead technical discussion and workshops
- Provide technical expertise in Google products to students/faculty
- Act as a liaison between GA Tech and Google

positions.title: Software Engineer- One Note Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced the performance of OneNote’s bitmap rendering feature by implementing multi-threaded C++ solutions, improving load times and user responsiveness.
• Developed and maintained unit tests for image preview components in C#, ensuring stability and preventing regressions during rapid release cycles
• Standardized and updated legacy code documentation, improving codebase maintainability and onboarding speed for new developers

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: As a data collection researcher I was tasked with compiling online data and communicating this data with research experts in Georgia Tech Public Public Policy Department..

positions.title: Google CSSI Intern
positions.description:
The Google Computer Science Summer Institute is a fun and intensive three week training program for High School grads at Google's HQ in Mountain View, California. The program is designed for beginner and intermediate computer scientist but welcomes experts as well. The program includes learning various programming languages and techniques(python, java, css, HTML, etc.) as well as working with some of the most highly-skilled software engineers/developers in the world.
--My team planned and developed an informal event hosting web-app. The objective of the app was for sharing details with guest without giving too much permission to the guest- keeping things very informational vs social.

positions.title: Computational Thinking Officer
positions.description:
My roles:
--Study and design activities that require computational thinking and learning.
--Educate middle school students in understanding, designing, and implementing algorithms.
--Facilitate student activities in a fun, safe, and professional manner.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
BFIG is an install group for alternative energy products. BFIG is certified in geothermal by Geosystem Inc. and Hydro Heat Inc.
My task:
--Create a business plan that communicated the company mission and expertise
